# Rheome brand assets

The Rheome mark is a **spiral focus** — streamlines of a flow spiralling out of a fixed point (rotation plus
divergence). It is a sibling of the neurodynamics·xr mark (a saddle, whose separatrices form an X) and the
Cortical Flow eye (a centre): the three fixed points of a 2-D flow. Colour = position along the flow,
nxr green-50 → magenta-50 (dark) / green-70 → magenta-60 (light), from the nxr-design-system tokens.

| file | use |
|---|---|
| `rheome-readme-header-{dark,light}.svg` | README header (`<picture>`, outlined text, transparent) |
| `rheome-mark-dark-tile.svg`, `rheome-mark-light-bare.svg` | the mark, ≥ 64 px |
| `rheome-mark-small-dark-tile.svg`, `rheome-favicon.ico` | the mark, ≤ 48 px (fewer, heavier strokes) |
| `rheome-social-preview-1280x640.png` | GitHub social preview (Settings → Social preview) |

Generated; do not edit by hand. The full set (PNG 16–1024, lockups, wordmarks) is kept in the
neurodynamics-xr brand library.
